simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תַּנְחֻמֶת (H8576) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תַּנְחֻמֶת (Tanchumeth) means Tanchumeth , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 25 23.

definitions.full: H8576. Tanchumeth תַּנְחֻ֫מֶת proper name, masculine (? Lag BN 126 f. thinks feminine ) parent of Seraiah, a Hebrew captain, after fall of Jerusalem Jer 40:8 = 2Kin 25:23 ( Lag l.c. conjecture תסחמת , Egyptian name). נַחְנוּ see אֲנַחְנוּ b above
